reason: Recurring class: Nimish types UNLOCK on a locked Athena spec and a proof must change. The trace shows the amendment was done carefully (only the named check changed, relocked, each spec proven alone, the known gap written down), and that practice should be the default next time. It is a distinct class from building or scoping a new spec.
UNLOCK amendment is a proof-integrity procedure; now the "Locked spec amendments (UNLOCK)" section of done-verification. Its evidence file is promoter-owned and goes with the archived directory.
